transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been troubling you or what brings you in today?

Um, well, mostly I just can't make myself do anything anymore. I just sit in my room... usually wearing the same clothes. I stopped doing the things I used to like, so I don't knit or journal or go walking now. My mom brought me in today because when she asks me what's wrong, I barely even have the energy to answer her.
Have you been feeling down or having little pleasure in doing things lately?

I don't really think I feel down or sad. I'm not crying or anything like that. I just... I don't really feel much of anything at all. As for pleasure, I guess I just don't care enough to even try doing anything fun anymore. It's more like everything is just blank.
Have you noticed that you don't enjoy things that you used to find pleasurable, or do you find it hard to get interested in activities at all?

Um, yeah, like I was just saying... I don't really enjoy anything anymore. I don't have the interest to even try doing my old hobbies, like the knitting or journaling. It's just... I just don't care to do them. I don't really know what else to say about it.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has it been at least two weeks, or more like several months?

It's been a lot longer than two weeks. Um, this whole decline... it's been going on since I started the community college program. That was about two years and two months ago, I think. So, yeah, it's been a really long time.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or have trouble sitting still?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I mean, I sit around a lot because I'm not doing much these days, but... I don't think I'm moving in slow motion or anything when I actually do get up. And I definitely don't have trouble sitting still. I'm mostly just... still, all the time.
Do you feel like you have very little energy, or do you get tired very easily even without doing much?

Um, no, not really. I don't feel physically tired or exhausted. I mean, I'm not doing much to get tired from anyway, but... it's not really a lack of energy. It's just that I don't have the motivation to do anything. So, no, I wouldn't say I get tired easily.
Would you say you have a depressed mood most of the day, nearly every day, or do you mostly just feel numb or empty?

Um, I wouldn't say I feel depressed or sad. I don't really feel much of anything most days. It's more like... I just feel empty or numb, like you said. I don't really have any strong emotions at all, good or bad. I'm just kind of here.
When something used to make you happy happens, like maybe seeing a friend or finishing a project, does it still bring you any sense of satisfaction or pleasure, even a little bit?

No, it doesn't really... I don't feel anything from it. Mostly I just can't make myself do anything anymore anyway. I used to knit, and journal, and I liked going for walks, but... I don't do any of that now. I just sit in my room. I usually just stay in the same clothes. Even when my mom comes in and asks what's wrong, I just... I barely have the energy to even answer her. It's just nothing.
Have you found yourself feeling like you're not worth much, or blamed yourself for things more than usual?

No, I don't really feel that way. I don't feel like I'm worthless or anything, and I don't really blame myself for things. I just... I don't really feel much at all, like I said. So, no, I haven't noticed feeling guilty or bad about myself.
When you're around people or in situations that used to make you happy, do you notice that you don't react to them the way you used to, even a little?

No, I don't really react at all. Even if it's something that used to be fun, or if someone is trying to make me laugh, I just... I don't feel anything, so I don't react. My face just stays the same. I don't smile or anything. It's just flat.
Have you noticed that nothing really seems to affect your mood or feelings at all, like even big events or things that used to really matter to you don’t seem to make any difference emotionally?

No, I don't think it's like that. I mean, I already said I don't feel much of anything, but... I don't know if big events would change that. Nothing big has really happened. So I can't say for sure if it would make a difference or not. I just know how I feel right now.
Even when something good happens, like someone says something nice to you or you get a small reward, does it feel like you can't react to it at all, like it doesn't register emotionally?

I'm not really sure. Um... people don't really give me rewards or say nice things to me lately, so I haven't really noticed. I guess I just don't have those kinds of things happen to me right now... so I can't really say if it registers or not.
